Knitted beanie with a folded rib cuff; optional slouch and pom-pom.

Soft bucket hat with a downward-sloping brim.
Close-fitting rounded skullcap (kufi, taqiyah, kippah-style) covering the top of the head.

length.doc: choker (0) to long (1)

assets.description: Ring on a finger, plain band or with a stone.

masculinity.doc: 0 = feminine anatomy (narrower shoulders, wider hips, softer jaw), 1 = masculine

headScale.doc: head size relative to the body

torsoLength.doc: torso length relative to the legs

forearmRatio.doc: forearm length relative to the upper arm

thighRatio.doc: thigh length relative to the shin

stylization.doc: 0 = realistic proportions, 1 = stylized cartoon (bigger head and eyes, simpler features, softer forms)

craniumHeight.doc: height of the top of the head

foreheadSlope.doc: how much the forehead slopes back

chinProjection.doc: how far the chin comes forward

lidHood.doc: upper lid fold covering the crease

lipProjection.doc: how far the lips come forward

cupidsBow.doc: definition of the upper lip curve

earProtrusion.doc: how far the ears stick out

irisSize.doc: iris size relative to the eye

freckles.doc: amount of freckles on the nose and cheeks

wrinkles.doc: forehead lines, crow’s feet, smile lines

stubble.doc: shaved beard shadow on the jaw and upper lip

lipAmount.doc: how strongly the lip colour shows

thickness.doc: brow height / thickness

density.doc: number of hairs

angle.doc: inner ends lower (+, stern) or higher (−, worried)

length.doc: length toward the temples

tail.doc: how much the outer tail drops
